description: Defines a lock-free single producer single consumer (SPSC) queue class for managing RLC SDUs with discard and tracking capabilities, used in a radio communication protocol implementation.

classes.name: rlc_sdu_queue_lockfree
classes.description: A lock-free FIFO buffer for RLC SDUs supporting discard, concurrent access, and buffer state tracking.

classes.name: state_t
classes.description: Structure representing the current number of SDUs and bytes in the queue.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Attempts to enqueue an RLC SDU, considering capacity and discard rules.

methods.name: try_discard
methods.description: Marks an SDU with a specific PDCP SN as discarded if possible.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Dequeues an SDU, skipping discarded ones, and updates buffer state.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Provides access to the front SDU, skipping discarded ones, and updates buffer state.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current number of SDUs and bytes in the buffer.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: is_full
methods.description: Checks if the queue is full.

methods.name: check_and_release
methods.description: Checks if an SDU with a given PDCP SN is valid and releases its slot.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if an SDU with a given PDCP SN is valid.

methods.name: state_add
methods.description: Atomically increments the buffer state by one SDU and its size.

methods.name: state_sub
methods.description: Atomically decrements the buffer state by one SDU and its size.
